Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
pallando wrote:
>
> can loquipment be moved using the heidelberg castle? and is it transferred
> to the diablerizing vampire?
> i'd say no in both cases because it says on the cards that loquipment
> doesn't count as equipment while in play.

Correct.

> something different: is memories of mortality burned when the methuselah who
> played it is ousted?

If she still controls it, yes.
All cards a Methuselah controls are burned when she is ousted, including
cards "on" cards controlled by other Methuselahs.
